Pokemon XD Gen2 Split Builder v4.11.5

Select your Pokemon XD ISO/GCM once. Generate a self-contained 368RealtimeBattleDXGen2 with battle arenas/VFX/triggers, or generate the independent 368PackDXGen2 + 368ImporterDXGen2 Pokemon/ecology system.

Validated primarily against USA GXXE01. The realtime battle mod is generated directly from the ISO and needs no separate battle pack. The Pokemon importer unlocks after 368PackDXGen2 is generated because its manifest records that pack's exact size/MD5.

Standalone Gen2 Pokemon/ecology side: 368PackDXGen2 contains only Pokemon mesh, texture, skeleton and animation data; 368ImporterDXGen2 contains follower/route-wild/Ground/Flying/Water Ecology and Pokemon-model runtime/performance logic. Battle VFX/stages are excluded.

Independent installs: 368RealtimeBattleDXGen2 works without 368ImporterDXGen2. 368ImporterDXGen2 + 368PackDXGen2.zip works without the realtime battle mod. Install both only when you want realtime battles to use the XD Pokemon models.

Licensing / source note

No Pokemon model, texture, battle-stage or WZX game asset is embedded in this HTML. Those assets are generated locally from the ISO you select; battle stages/VFX go into the realtime battle mod while Pokemon assets go into 368PackDXGen2. The existing converter/runtime source notices from the component builders remain applicable.
